Distinguish a missing cash RTH from an overnight trading session and from a CME clearing trade date.
Declare whether prior day means previous calendar weekday or previous eligible trading session. For prior week/month, declare how full closures and partial RTH sessions contribute.
Keep instrument identity fixed unless a separately declared roll-reference definition explicitly changes it.
Do not replace an unavailable calendar entry with assumed normal hours. Do not synthesize a price on closed minutes.
Record new policy and input hashes, exposure and denominators before any follow-on outcome replay.
